consent.title: AI Data Sharing Disclosure
consent.subtitle: Before using AI features, please review how your data is used.
consent.diaryData: Typed prompts, chat messages, and diary entries
consent.memoryData: Memory Garden entries and wellness goals
consent.socialData: Social media profile URLs and bio text (when using import features)
consent.recipient: Google (Gemini AI models) via the Lovable AI Gateway. Your data is transmitted securely via encrypted connections.
consent.purpose: To generate personalized AI responses, voice synthesis, proactive greetings, health coaching, and profile enrichment suggestions.
consent.notStored: Data is not permanently stored by the AI provider
consent.revokeAnytime: You can revoke consent anytime in Settings > Privacy
consent.gdprCompliant: Compliant with GDPR and privacy regulations
consent.agreementFooter: By tapping 'I Agree', you give Exafy LTD permission to send the data listed above to the named AI service providers. You can withdraw this permission at any time in Settings > Privacy.

limitations.description: These are the non-negotiable rules we apply to every product recommendation. Allergies, medical contraindications, and medication interactions are never overridable.
limitations.medicationsLabel: Medications (generic or class, e.g. SSRI, blood-thinner)
